notes: Source fragments are exact RGB crops. Only alpha is edited in cutouts; mobile files use deterministic resizing/palette encoding.

Five hero compositions are separate. Create alone contains its original orange flag. Ready/gallery original capsule overlap and ready adjacent heading are cleared in alpha; render against the native sky/cream underlay.
Park-stage crops contain original public/sample flags, own-location sample or clue illustration when present. Explicit developer preview only; never geographic runtime maps.

Unknown pixels hidden behind original HUD/panels have not been invented or repainted. Mouse-win adjacent title occlusion is removed in alpha without repainting hidden art; its map stage stops at y893 before the tail protrusion.
Drawer park crop already includes its original dimming; do not add another dim mask unless replacing it with a bright-stage crop.
Every resize specifies width only. Integer output-height rounding is recorded by source/crop/runtime aspectRatio; no nonuniform scaling is applied.
